move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your cost model and demand forecast; this verified data permits a minor adjustment to our pricing. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. A lead time of 42 days introduces severe operational inefficiencies; we must therefore maintain our standard 54 days. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

decisions.tactician: o3 and o4 reach the lowest C among the options (€1,416,340), meeting our 42 d lead requirement and full volume, versus E0 and o1 at €1,449,940 with 56 d lead. o4's 36-month term best serves the supplier's strong need for planning security and justifies releasing allocated capacity, which offsets the -7 % cash gap. That makes o4 likelier to be accepted or met with a reasonable counter than o3. o5 and o6 show the same C, but asking for 35 d strains a capacity-full plant for no gain. Price sits above the health level, so the relationship charge stays low. The cost model (a1) anchors the price, and our forecast rise (a3) shows real volume worth committing capacity to. We avoid the delivery-record argument so we don't antagonise a capacity-tight supplier.

decisions.tactician: o4 gives the lowest C listed (€1,440,838), better than E0 at 56 d (€1,474,438) at the same price. It also keeps the 36-month, full-volume commitment the supplier values, so it beats o3 and o5. Lead 42 d is our stated need and is less provocative than 35 d, which gives the same C. Citing the 79.5% on-time record supports the lead-time demand. The supplier is still moving at about €0.50 per reply, so countering is better than accepting offer:70410-1-a at €31.70.
